description: This file implements a React component for visualizing image differences such as expected, actual, and difference images, including features like sliders and side-by-side comparisons in a test result viewer. It also defines related types and functions for image loading and display.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Asynchronously loads an image from a given source URL and resolves when the image is loaded or if an error occurs.

methods.name: ImageDiffView
methods.description: React component that displays image differences with several viewing modes like diff, actual, expected, slider, and side-by-side.

methods.name: ImageDiffSlider
methods.description: Component providing a slider to compare expected and actual images interactively.

methods.name: ImageWithSize
methods.description: Helper component that displays an image with optional size and title annotations.
